description:
Shows a git diff with annotations in the VibeLens extension panel.

Use this tool after analyzing code changes to present the diff visually with your explanations.

The tool will:
1. Save the diff and annotations to the local SQLite database
2. Return a structured envelope with a reviewId for tracking

annotations.description: Annotations explaining specific parts of the diff

actions.description: Reviewer actions: specific, actionable suggestions for improvements

prompt.description: Full context: what to change, relevant code snippet, and why it would improve the code

explanation.description: Your explanation of this change — what the code does

file.description: File path the annotation refers to

line.description: Line number in the new file (optional)

diff.description: The raw git diff output as a string (unified diff format). IMPORTANT: Pass the actual diff content, not a file path or shell command.

title.description: Title for the explanation (e.g., 'Add user authentication')

workspacePath.description: Absolute path to the workspace/project folder. Used to attribute the review to the correct project.

name: show_diff_explanation
